name: Waldorf Astoria Panama
insider_take: Soaring above the glittering skyline of Panama City, the Waldorf Astoria Panama redefines luxury in a city that connects two oceans and the world.
whats_special: Occupying the top floors of the iconic The Point Tower — one of Panama's most recognizable skyscrapers — this Waldorf Astoria delivers breathtaking panoramic views of both the Pacific Ocean and the Panama Canal. Guests enjoy the legendary Waldorf Astoria True Waldorf Service , a dedicated Personal Concierge assigned to every guest, along with world-class dining, an elevated pool deck, and a sublime spa experience. Its location in the prestigious Punta Pacífica neighborhood puts guests steps from the finest shopping and dining Panama City has to offer.
pro_tip: Request a high-floor suite on the Pacific-facing side for unobstructed sunset views over the ocean — on clear days, you can spot ships queued to pass through the Panama Canal. Book through WhataHotel! for exclusive perks you won't find anywhere else.
dont_miss: Don't miss a visit to the Panama Canal's Miraflores Locks , just a short drive away — watching massive cargo ships navigate the locks is a bucket-list experience. Back at the hotel, indulge in cocktails at the sky-high bar as the city lights ignite below you at dusk.
pros: Iconic Skyscraper Setting with Panoramic City & Ocean Views
World-Class Spa & Rooftop Infinity Pool Experience
Prime Location in the Heart of Panama City's Financial District
Exceptional Fine Dining with International Cuisine & Craft Cocktails
Legendary Waldorf Astoria White Glove Service & Personalized Butler Amenities
cons: Urban City-Center Location — No Direct Beach or Resort-Style Waterfront Access
Ultra-Luxury Pricing May Not Suit All Budgets
